sentence: Can you ___ me the time, please?

full_script: [excited] ¡Completa la frase! Número uno. Can you ___ me the time, please? Las opciones son: A, tell. B, say. C, speak. D, talk. [thoughtful] Piensa bien... Tres... dos... uno... [excited] ¡La respuesta es A, tell! Tell lleva a la persona detrás: tell me. Say me no existe. Número dos. She ___ that she was tired. Las opciones son: A, said. B, told. C, spoke. D, talked. [thoughtful] Piensa bien... Tres... dos... uno... [excited] ¡La respuesta es A, said! Sin persona detrás, say. She said that... Si añades a quién, she told me that.
